title: Open-world people 1: campers and nature spirits
prompt: A line-up of blocky voxel characters at the same scale, each front-on and from the high three-quarter game angle: Katie Gardner, a daughter of Demeter, brown braid, straw hat, green overalls over the orange camp shirt, a trowel and a basket of strawberries; Travis and Connor Stoll, sons of Hermes, lanky twin pranksters with curly brown hair and mischievous grins, one holding a stolen bag; Juniper, a tree nymph with green-tinged skin, leaf-green hair and a dress of juniper needles; Charles Beckendorf, a big son of Hephaestus in a leather apron and goggles with a bronze wrench; Lee Fletcher, a son of Apollo with sandy hair, a golden bow and a quiver; and a Nereid, a sea nymph with sea-green hair, pearls and a robe like foam. 3D game art in the blocky voxel style of Minecraft Dungeons: characters built from cubes, with a large cube head whose face is simple pixel art (about 8 × 8 pixels: pixel eyes, a pixel mouth, hair drawn as pixels and as a few blocky tufts), a boxy torso, square arms and legs, crisp pixel-art textures (about 16 pixels per block) with simple shading, chunky readable silhouettes; warm cinematic lighting, soft ambient occlusion and glowing magic effects. Costume colours and details follow the Camp Half-Blood cartoon concept art. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. Flat light-grey background, no cast shadow. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
